g.aria-label: Preserving the Global Batch Invariant When Scaling GPU Count
What Breaks If You Forget to Adjust N_acc
Halves optimizer steps for fixed token budget
If keeping 2× batch: scale Adam LR by √2
and define warmup in TOKENS, not steps!
Always log B_global and tokens consumed alongside step count.
Communication floor: as N_acc → 1, un-overlapped allreduce t_ar caps max multi-GPU speedup.
